identity.name: VendezVotreCar
identity.design_philosophy: Clarity over decoration. The user wants to sell a car, not admire a gallery. Use high-contrast typography, clear action signals (Green = Go/Money), and reassuring imagery.

styles.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tighter leading-[1.1] text-zinc-950
styles.caption: text-sm text-zinc-500 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider

primary.description: Emerald Green. Used for Primary CTAs (Get Offer, Sell Now). Symbolizes Money and Go.

secondary.description: Zinc 950 (Asphalt). Used for strong headers, footer, and secondary actions.

accent.description: Amber. Use sparingly for alerts or 'Important' tags.

buttons.primary: bg-[#10B981] hover:bg-[#059669] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-bold text-lg shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/20 transition-all hover:-translate-y-1
buttons.secondary: bg-white border-2 border-zinc-200 text-zinc-900 hover:border-zinc-900 rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-all
buttons.ghost: text-zinc-600 hover:text-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-100 rounded-lg px-4 py-2

cards.style: bg-white border border-zinc-200 rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 hover:border-emerald-500/50 transition-colors duration-300

inputs.style: h-14 bg-white border-2 border-zinc-200 rounded-xl px-4 text-lg focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-0 transition-colors placeholder:text-zinc-400

badges.trust: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-bold border border-emerald-100

hero.description: Left side: Heavy typography, Value Prop, Primary CTA. Right side: High-quality image bleeding to edge or shaped with a mask.
hero.classes: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 items-center min-h-[80vh]

form_wizard.description: Clean, centered card on a subtle background. Progress bar at top. One major question per step.
form_wizard.container: max-w-2xl mx-auto bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-xl shadow-zinc-200/50 p-8 md:p-12 border border-zinc-100

grid_bento.description: Use for 'How it works' or 'Why us'. varied span sizes.

Happy person holding keys. Use for 'Sold' or 'Testimonials' section.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5 or 2. Color: Zinc-900 or Emerald-600.

motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }} transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: 'easeOut' }}

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is Zinc-600 or darker on light backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Focus rings must be Emerald-500 (2px offset).
accessibility.labels: All inputs must have visible labels or aria-labels.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE TAILWIND CONFIG: Replace the blue/orange brand colors with the new Emerald/Zinc palette.
2. REFACTOR HERO: Move away from the 'gradient overlay' style to a clean, split-screen layout with the new images.
3. UPDATE FORM: Style the multi-step form to look like a premium 'Wizard' (Card based, large inputs, clear progress).
4. DO NOT BREAK FUNCTIONALITY: The form logic (steps, upload, submission) must remain intact. Only change the UI/UX layer.
5. USE LUCIDE ICONS: Replace any old icons with clean Lucide versions.
6. ADD MICRO-INTERACTIONS: Use Framer Motion for step transitions in the form.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
